title: feat(lint): warn when another permission set's View All, Modify All or viewAllFields re-opens a field one set hides
body:
repo:objectstack#7 · os-alice · session_011y7As5bdhV5T4N9vpjmZzH

Fixes #36052

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:应用作者在一个权限集里隐藏或锁定某字段、另一个权限集又对同一对象开了"查看全部/修改全部/查看全部字段"时,校验与 Studio 会给出一条警告,点名两个权限集和该字段;通配对象上写"查看全部字段"会和另外两个超级位一样报错。
- 为什么做:属于字段权限轴拆分这一安全决策的第二步,替以为字段已被隐藏、实际仍被另一权限集读到的应用作者提前发现问题。
- 出错会怎样:新规则只是警告,今天能构建的应用不会因此停构;最坏情况是多出或漏掉一条提示,可直接撤回本改动。
- 要你做什么:无

## What changes

- **New warning `security-cross-set-field-reopen`** in `packages/lint/src/validate-security-posture.ts`. For a field that one set hides (`readable: false`) or edit-locks, and that another set re-opens through `viewAllRecords` (View All), `modifyAllRecords` (Modify All) or `viewAllFields` on the object (its own entry for the object, else its `'*'` entry, a lookup, never a merge), it reports one finding per hiding row and re-opening set, on the hiding row's path, naming both sets and the field. The hint carries the ruled steering: drop the bit, give the second set its own `readable: false` row (beside View All / `viewAllFields` only), say `viewAllFields: true` when the second set should read every field, or, for a field that must stay hidden from everyone without a capability, declare `requiredPermissions` on the field (ADR-0066 D3) plus a `maskingRule` where a partial value is needed.
- The second set's vote is read the way `superuserFieldVote` in `@objectstack/core` reads it: Modify All votes read and edit on every field; View All and `viewAllFields` vote read only, and cast no read vote on a field the same set's own row declares `readable: false`.
- **Not reported:** a field gated by `requiredPermissions` (that AND-gate is folded in after the merge, so no set's bit opens it); an edit lock beside View All or `viewAllFields` (they never vote an edit); a key on an object this stack does not define, or naming a field the object does not declare (`security-fls-unknown-field` owns that); any judgement by field name.
- **No double report with `security-superuser-field-mask-inert`.** That rule owns the same-set case (a set's own Modify All unbinding its own row). The new rule skips any hiding row whose own set holds Modify All on the object, so that row gets exactly one finding, from the same-set rule. Beside its own View All alone, a set's row still binds its holders (the 2026-11-15 note), so it is judged here against the other sets. Both rules' `os explain` entries now point at each other.
- **`security-wildcard-vama` reads `viewAllFields`** on a package-authored `'*'` entry (scope widened by L2 record 7063858938, card comment 7063882080). **Error, not warning**, the same tier as the two record bits, because: the wildcard bit is the field half of the same package-authored superuser (a read vote on every field of every object, other packages' objects included); the organization boundary already refuses to distribute such a set (the delegated-admin gate's condition (a) reads the three bits alike); and the key is not in any release yet (its changeset `.changeset/36050-view-all-fields-bit.md` is still pending), so no stack a released version accepted stops building. A wildcard with the record bits keeps its message; the hint names every bit present. `viewAllFields` on an object's own entry is not reported by this rule.
- Rule text in `rule-explanations.ts` (new entry, plus the two neighbouring entries updated), user sentences in `validate-security-posture.user-text.ts` for every platform locale, the id exported from `packages/lint/src/index.ts`, and a `patch` changeset for `@objectstack/lint`.

## Why

Ruling 6912661484 on #34365, step 2: an author who hides a field from one role with a `readable: false` row is not told that a holder of another set with View All on the object reads it anyway (the hotcrm#2481 case). Field grants union without deny, so the warning is the only place the author learns of it before the field-axis split makes View All / Modify All stop voting on fields.

## Tests

New file `packages/lint/src/validate-security-posture-cross-set-field-reopen-36052.test.ts` (16 cases), plus updates to `validate-security-posture.test.ts` and `finding-user-text.test.ts`. The card's acceptance fixtures map as: two-set hide + View All fires; + Modify All fires (read and edit); + `viewAllFields` on the second set fires (own entry and `'*'`); one set alone does not; a `requiredPermissions` field does not. The wildcard rule has three cases (bit alone is an error naming it; one finding with all three bits; record-bit wording kept, per-object and `false` bits not reported).

## Acceptance notes

- `holdsViewAllFields` in lint is a copy of the private helper of the same name in `@objectstack/core` (`security/effective-object-permissions.ts`); lint does not depend on core. The two copies read the bit identically today (own entry else `'*'`, `=== true`); noted, not filed.
- `packages/lint/src/index.ts` (one export line) is outside the claim's declared file surface; it is the barrel the new rule id needs to be importable like its siblings.
- An edit lock is read as `editable !== true`, so a row that declares only `readable: false` is also an edit lock; the explanation says `editable` omitted parses to false.
